# DOZR

> > Online marketplace for heavy equipment rentals including compact track loaders, aerial lifts, and compaction equipment across North America

DOZR connects contractors and construction professionals with equipment suppliers across the United States and Canada. The platform offers instant online booking for track loaders (Bobcat, Vermeer, Ditch Witch), boom lifts, scissor lifts, and compaction equipment with transparent daily pricing starting from $209.

## Key Topics

- Compact Track Loaders
- Aerial Lifts & Boom Lifts
- Scissor Lifts
- Compaction Equipment
- Bobcat Equipment (MT52, MT55, MT85, MT100)
- Vermeer Equipment (S925TX)
- Ditch Witch Equipment (SK600, SK800, SK1050)
- Walk-Behind Skid Steers
- Earthmoving Equipment
- Construction Equipment Rental
- Landscaping Equipment
- DOZR Supplier Network
- Daily Rental Pricing
- North American Equipment Marketplace
